messages:
rita: Observed weirdness: user devices falling back from SSE->WS keep the session id and both protocols accepted the same resume -> duplicate assistant responses and two resume charges. Happened after we enabled ws-fallback for a canary.
sam: logs?
rita: snippet:
```
[2025-04-17T11:08:12Z] sse: conn=sse-19 session=ss:900 accept=ok route=na-south-1
[2025-04-17T11:08:13Z] ws: conn=ws-3 session=ss:900 accept=ok route=na-south-2
[2025-04-17T11:08:24Z] billing: session=ss:900 resume_charge=1 route=na-south-1
[2025-04-17T11:08:25Z] billing: session=ss:900 resume_charge=1 route=na-south-2
```
infra-bot: ALERT duplicate-session-detect count=12 window=10m
devex: SDK question: do clients reuse the exact resume token across protocol fallback?
sam: yes. client lib does immediate fallback to ws and re-sends resume token. We relied on route-level idempotency which apparently doesn't exist.
product-joe: customers reported doubled messages and unexpected charges. We need both a quick mitigation and a robust fix.
billing: short-term we can identify obvious double-charges (same session id, 90s window) and credit automatically, but we need infra changes to avoid recurrence.
devex: quick mitigation: turn off ws-fallback for canary cohorts and add a soft-throttle in SDK so fallback waits randomized 500-1500ms if resume token present. That reduces races.
rita: infra mitigation options: 1) central claim ledger (accept lease) checked on accept; 2) accept nonce embedded in resume token signed by control plane; 3) route-side kvcache CAS against a global key.
sam: central claim ledger simplest conceptually: route does claim(session)->owner=routeX ttl=20s. Compare-and-set prevents dual accept. Cost: extra RPC on accept.
devex: clients need new error handling for ACCEPTED_ELSEWHERE to reattempt with jitter. SDK change small but necessary.
product-joe: we should also change console UX: show "claim owner" column and a tooltip explaining transient reclaims and billing implications. Reduce support confusion.
rita: plan: immediate: toggle ws-fallback off for canary (done) + SDK soft-throttle. Medium: implement accept-lease RPC in control plane and route changes to CAS on accept. Long: consider route cookie handshake for sticky routing after verification.
infra-bot: ACTION: ws-fallback rolled back for 20% canary at 2025-04-17T11:15:00Z by infra-bot.
sam: I'll open infra ticket INFRA-11011 for accept-lease RPC prototype. devex please add SDK change ticket.
devex: opened SDK-912 with ACCEPTED_ELSEWHERE handling.
billing: I'll start dedupe instrumentation and a temporary auto-credit rule for suspected duplicates. Legal signed off to test for 1 week.
console-bot: DRAFT dashboard /dashboards/streaming/session-claims created and linked to INFRA-11011.
product-joe: good. communicate to CS and post support status.
rita: launching 10% canary for accept-lease once infra prototype lands. monitor duplicate_response_rate and billing alerts.
